title: C: Strategy Pattern
description: Implement the Strategy pattern that allows selecting an algorithm at runtime via function pointers.

steps.title: Sorting Strategies
steps.description: Define a `Strategy` function pointer type: `void (*sort_fn)(int*, int)`. Implement bubble sort and insertion sort strategies. Write a `context_execute` function that takes a strategy and runs it. Test both strategies on the same array.
hints: bubble_sort and insertion_sort match the signature.
Print the sorted array after each strategy.

verification.failureMessage: Sort the array using both strategies
